run_preprocess_index_data: run the preprocess module to index text data with a vocabulary file and output a binary .pth file
create_dictionary_read_vocab: create a Dictionary object by reading a vocabulary file with word and count on each line
test_dictionary_index_data: test the Dictionary.index_data function to convert text into indexed sentence data
run_preprocess_log_unknown_words: run the preprocess module to log unknown words and their coverage percentage in the dataset
run_preprocess_convert_text_to_binary: run the preprocess module to convert a text file into a binary .pth file using a given vocabulary
